title: Shift Handover Notes: Reporting Daily Output
description: Foundational workplace English module covering shift handover notes: reporting daily output.
learning_objectives: Master professional Past Simple vs Present Simple in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in shift handover notes: reporting daily output
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: Yesterday during shift 2, the assembly line mechanic _____ the differential gear casing with a calibrated pneumatic impact driver.

explanations.correct: Specific completed time 'yesterday' strictly requires Past Simple 'tightened'.
explanations.wrong_A: Base form 'tighten' lacks past tense inflection.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect 'has tightened' cannot co-occur with specific past adverbial 'yesterday'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Continuous describes current actions, not yesterday's finished events.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses the same past form, but in English, 'yesterday' strictly requires Past Simple ('tightened'), never Present Perfect.
